# ES8311 initialization reference

The ES8311 initialization sequence and 16 kHz clock coefficients in `firmware/src/board_audio.cpp` are adapted from Espressif's [esp_codec_dev ES8311 driver](https://github.com/espressif/esp-adf/blob/release/v2.x/components/esp_codec_dev/device/es8311/es8311.c).

SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) CO LTD

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The adaptation uses Arduino Wire, fixed 16 kHz / 16-bit I2S, 4.096 MHz MCLK, a 24 dB analog microphone gain, no DAC reference channel, and software playback volume. The full [Apache 2.0 license](es8311/LICENSE) is included.
